facts.text: Southwestern Adventist University operates an annual dinosaur excavation project in Wyoming and houses the Dinosaur Science Museum, which displays a collection of over 25,000 fossil bones.

sources.title: Dinosaur Research Draws World-Wide Acclaim, Inspires New TV Series
sources.quote: Big things are happening with Southwestern Adventist University's Dinosaur Research Project. With its Dinosaur Science Museum housing a world-class collection of over 25,000 bones and ever-increasing media exposure, the project is drawing unprecedented attention.
